ns2:course.label: FAA Study Abroad
ns2:course.description: Provides campus credit for foreign study and/or travel. A detailed proposal for study abroad must be submitted for approval by the appropriate committee of the department in which the student is studying and the college dean's office prior to such study abroad. Final determination of credit and its application toward the degree is made after a review of the student's work abroad by the above committee and college office. (summer session, 0 to 6 undergraduate hours). Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Junior standing in the department; approval of the student's proposal by the departmental committee and the college office.
